//: Strict type-check over the client/schema/util layers only. The MCP tool files under src/tools/** are excluded because the SDK's tool() generics (typed against zod v4) vs this package's zod v3 trigger a TypeScript instantiation-depth blow-up that OOMs a full check. Those files are transpiled (not type-checked) at build time; their behaviour is covered by the jest suite. src/remote/** (the hosted OAuth server) is included: it reaches the tool modules only through a factory the entry points inject, so checking it does not pull in src/tools/**.
